create_VideoMAEVideoProcessor: create a VideoMAEVideoProcessor instance configured for VideoMAE model video preprocessing with 224x224 crop size
run_VideoMAEVideoProcessor_preprocess: run the preprocess method on video inputs to produce batched pixel_values tensors for VideoMAE model inference
configure_VideoMAEVideoProcessor_size: configure the VideoMAEVideoProcessor resize and crop size to 224x224 with BILINEAR resampling for VideoMAE models
configure_VideoMAEVideoProcessor_normali: configure the VideoMAEVideoProcessor normalization using ImageNet mean and standard deviation with 1/255 rescale factor
review_VideoMAEVideoProcessor: review the VideoMAEVideoProcessor class that extends BaseVideoProcessor and overrides preprocess to rename pixel_values_videos to pixel_values
